question: Where can I get a list of urban wastewater treatment plants in Spain, with location, design capacity, treated volume and treatment level?

answer.summary: Spain reports its plants to the EU under Directive 91/271/CEE. The EEA public layer (ArcGIS REST, 2,138 Spanish plants, status 31/12/2022) has coordinates, design capacity (p.e.), treatment flags and treated volume (m3/year, filled for 1,666). MITECO publishes the same report as GeoPackage with 2,357 plants but only name/id/status. Plants below the reporting threshold exist only in regional lists.
main_caveats: EEA and MITECO layers are Spain's UWWTD report at 31/12/2022 (Q2023); the EEA output is flagged provisional pending the Commission compliance check.
uwwCapacity and load are in population equivalents (p.e.), not m3/day; Spain notes capacity is a mean project capacity while load is the weekly maximum, so load can exceed capacity (227 plants).
MITECO GPKG (INSPIRE form) has no capacity, volume or treatment fields; the SHP with those fields sits behind an Altcha download page and the WMS host fails TLS validation.
Capacity differs between sources: BOE 2025 gives 19,632 p.e. for the Mazagon expansion, EEA layer 53,140 p.e. for MAZAGON; reason not established.
Regional codes differ: ACA codi_aglomeracio ES09080010001010 equals EEA uwwCode ES9080010001010E (leading 0 dropped, E added).
answer.confidence_reason: Core fields were queried and counted on the live EEA service; MITECO SHP, OSM for Spain and several regions were not opened, and EEA data is provisional.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -s -G 'https://water.discomap.eea.europa.eu/arcgis/rest/services/WISE_UWWTD/TreatmentPlants_2022/MapServer/0/query' --data-urlencode "where=rptMStateKey='ES'" --data-urlencode 'outFields=*' --data-urlencode 'orderByFields=OBJECTID' --data-urlencode 'resultOffset=0' --data-urlencode 'resultRecordCount=1000' --data-urlencode 'returnGeometry=false' --data-urlencode 'f=json'   (repeat with resultOffset=1000 and 2000; count query: same URL with returnCountOnly=true returns {"count":2138})
steps: Filter rptMStateKey='ES' (server limit 2,000 records per call, so page with resultOffset).
Keep OBJECTID ordering to avoid duplicates; uwwCode is unique in the 2,138 rows.
With returnGeometry=false use uwwLatitude/uwwLongitude as coordinates.
Treatment level: primary=1 in all 2,138 rows; 1,165 also have more stringent=1 plus secondary=1, 942 secondary only, 26 primary only, 5 primary plus more stringent.
Convert volume with m3/year; divide by 1e6 for hm3 (sum over the 1,666 filled rows = 3,754 hm3).
Join with MITECO GPKG on uwwCode = inspireId_Identifier_localId (all 2,138 match).
reading_traps: uwwWasteWaterTreated is null in 472 of 2,138 Spanish plants; uwwMethodWasteWaterTreated is null in 781 (M 796, C 480, E 81).
Capacity is in p.e., not flow; 227 plants report load above capacity and Spain's remarks (251 plants) explain that capacity is a project mean while load is the weekly maximum.
uwwSpecification (other treatment detail) is filled in only 126 plants; uwwHyperlink in 439; uwwInspireIDFacility in 13.
repCode has trailing spaces (padded to 50 characters); strip before comparing.
Coordinate check: 0 of 2,138 points fall outside Spain's bounding box; 0 fall outside the expected box for Canarias, Baleares, Ceuta, Melilla, Cataluna and Madrid.

problems: Provisional until the Commission compliance check ends (stated in the metadata)

evidence.quote: Dataset UWWTD_TreatmentPlants contains urban waste water treatment plants and collecting systems without UWWTP, including their coordinates, capacity and actual load treated, type of treatment and data on the performance of plants.
Current output is provisional, as it is subject to the Commission's compliance check, following which some records may be amended and further information will be added.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -o dep_gpkg.zip "https://www.miteco.gob.es/content/dam/miteco/es/cartografia-y-sig/ide/descargas/depuradorasq2023_gpkg.zip"; python3 -I with sqlite3: select name, inspireId_Identifier_localId, status_xlink_title from EnvironmentalManagementFacility limit 2
steps: Download the GPKG zip (static link, no form).
Open the GPKG with sqlite3; table EnvironmentalManagementFacility, geometry column geom, EPSG:4326.
Filter status_xlink_title = functional to drop 35 decommissioned.
Join to the EEA layer on localId = uwwCode to bring capacity, volume and treatment.
reading_traps: The GPKG is the INSPIRE reporting form: 19 columns, none for capacity, volume or treatment.
It has 2,357 plants against 2,138 in the EEA public layer; 35 are decommissioned despite the "active" definition.
The SHP/KMZ/GML links on gis.miteco.gob.es/descargas open an HTML page with an Altcha widget and a POST button, not a file; not followed.
The WMS host wms.mapama.gob.es fails TLS validation with curl and WebFetch (unknown CA).

steps: Catalonia: filter any=<latest closed year> to avoid triplicates (one row per system per year).
Madrid: request outputFormat=application/json; coordinates are EPSG:25830 metres.
Join to the EEA layer: EEA uwwCode = "ES" + codi_aglomeracio[3:] + "E" when codi_aglomeracio starts with ES0 (240 of 573 ACA rows match).
For regions not opened, search datos.gob.es titles containing "depuradoras" (apidata/catalog/dataset/title/depuradoras).
reading_traps: ACA rows repeat each system for 2024, 2025 and 2026 (1,715 rows total); counting rows overstates plants.
ACA habitants_equivalents is a string; 295 of 573 rows in 2025 are below 2,000 p.e.
Aragon resource 112 mixes plants under construction with in-service plants; Baleares CSV carries only names.
Madrid IDEM dataset record on datos.gob.es is dated 2015, the WFS itself returned 155 features on 2026-11-16.
No regional list opened gives treated volume per plant.

recipe: For a plant missing treated volume in the EEA layer, search the plant name and municipality in the BOE search and in the regional operator reports.

In a BOE environmental-assessment resolution, read the section "Características del proyecto": design capacity in p.e. and m3/day appear in one sentence (tested on BOE-A-2025-21097 with pdftotext -layout).
For Comunitat Valenciana, read the EPSAR annual report province table for treated volume; per-plant volume was not found there.
Compare the document figure with uwwCapacity of the same plant in the EEA layer before using either.
if_unstructured.location_method: Coordinates come from the EEA/MITECO layers or regional lists; the BOE document gives only a textual place (350 m north of Mazagon beach). The PNOA orthophoto and Catastro parcels can confirm a point.
